#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long mod = 998244353;

long long fastExpo(long long x, long long k) {
    if (k == 0) {
        return 1;
    } else if (k == 1) {
        return x % mod;
    } else {
        long long root = fastExpo(x, k / 2);
        long long ans = (root * root) % mod;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            ans = (ans * x) % mod;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}

long long modInv(long long x) {
    return fastExpo(x, mod - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long N, M, L, R;
    cin >> N >> M >> L >> R;

    long long total = R - L + 1;
    long long E = total / 2 + ((R % 2 == 0 && L % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0);
    long long O = total - E;

    long long ans;
    long long power = N * M;
    if (power % 2 == 1) {
        ans = fastExpo(E + O, power);
    } else {
        long long term1 = fastExpo(E + O, power);
        long long term2 = fastExpo(E - O, power);
        ans = (term1 + term2) % mod;
        ans = (ans * modInv(2)) % mod;
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
